messages:
anika: Hey folks — hit a strange failure onboarding llama-30b-q4 in eval-runner v2.1. CI uploads to artifact-store are 400ing with Content-Type mismatch. Works locally, fails in pipeline. stack trace below.

matt_h: can you paste the exact error/log lines?

anika: log: `HTTP 400 Bad Request: Content-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary=----WebKitForm...` but artifact-store expects `application/gzip` for .trace.gz. Some uploads are `application/octet-stream` too.

ci-bot: detected 8 failing uploads in pipeline #4823 :warning:

samir: saw a similar one yesterday with quantized traces — runner emits two parts: metadata (application/json) + payload (application/octet-stream) and our S3 proxy flattens them and expects a single gzipped blob.

linda: quick mitigation: set RUNNER_TRACE_FORMAT=single-gzip in env to force concat+gzip before upload. That reduces failures but not ideal.

kevin: we should add a normalization step in upload-client: coalesce parts -> single gzipped part and set Content-Type: application/gzip; charset=binary.

anika: careful — downstream consumers use `x-eval-trace-schema: v2` to decide streaming vs file. Propose adding `x-eval-trace-content: gz` header and update manifest so consumers can switch safely.

matt_h: also noticed artifact-store GC uses `created_at` from metadata, and re-uploads overwrite it, causing re-uploaded quantized variants to be GC'd early.

samir: reproduction steps I used: 

```
# simulate runner
python runner/upload_trace.py --file sample.trace.gz --meta '{"model":"llama-30b-q4","schema":"v2"}'
# manifest shows two parts
curl -I https://artifacts.internal/.../sample.trace
```

anika: CI wishlist: 
- unit test for multipart->single gzip normalization
- integration test that roundtrips x-eval-trace-schema and x-eval-trace-content
- ensure re-upload doesn't reset created_at (use etag+versioning header)

kevin: I'll open a patch in upload-client to coalesce parts and set the header. cc @ops-bot for s3-proxy change.

ops-bot: noted. I can add a proxy rule to accept multipart and synthesize application/gzip if parts appear gzippable. ETA EOD.

linda: can someone add a quick CI check in eval-runner to assert artifact-store responds 200 on upload and that HEAD shows original created_at preserved? simple e2e in CircleCI would do.

matt_h: also add a metric: eval.trace.upload.type counts by [single-gzip, multipart, octet] so we can monitor distribution.

anika: tagging this P1 for the onboarding run. I'll draft a short RFC for `x-eval-trace-content` and propose schema v3 with normalization rules.

samir: one more gotcha: quantized traces sometimes include per-token KV blobs >50MB which trigger chunked transfer encoding; our proxy currently drops content-length which breaks artifact-store validation. Need robust chunked handling.

kevin: noted. will include chunked-transfer handling and tests in the patch.

matt_h: if PRs land today we can roll to canary tomorrow. :rocket:

anika: thanks all — I'll follow up with PR links and a CI test plan in this thread shortly.
